crossRefs.note: For most certainly in this we groan, longing to be clothed with our habitation which is from heaven,
if indeed being clothed, we will not be found naked.
He moves his tail like a cedar. The sinews of his thighs are knit together.
His bones are like tubes of bronze. His limbs are like bars of iron.
Again he said to me, “Prophesy over these bones, and tell them, ‘You dry bones, hear Yahweh’s word.

translations.web: You have clothed me with skin and flesh, and knit me together with bones and sinews.
translations.bsb: You clothed me with skin and flesh, and knit me together with bones and sinews.
translations.kjv: Thou hast clothed me with skin and flesh, and hast fenced me with bones and sinews.
translations.asv: Thou hast clothed me with skin and flesh, And knit me together with bones and sinews.
